logline: A New York street gang leader pursues a mind-controlling drug conspiracy while forming an intense, emotionally charged bond with a Japanese photographer's assistant - MAPPA's adaptation of Akimi Yoshida's landmark manga.

renewal.note: 24-episode single-season adaptation completed December 20, 2018. Based on Akimi Yoshida's manga (1985-1994), produced to mark the author's 40th anniversary as a manga artist. The adaptation modernised the setting from 1980s to 2010s New York.

bollymeter.basis: IMDb 8.1 from audience ratings. Anime News Network weighted mean 7.655 (Very good). Rose Bridges' ANN review awarded A- for the premiere episodes, praising its crime drama momentum and MAPPA's production. One of Prime Video's most acclaimed global anime releases of 2018.

pull_quotes.text: All I feel when I finish an episode of Banana Fish is how much I want more.

seasons.review_body: Banana Fish aired on Fuji TV's Noitamina block from July to December 2018, with global simultaneous streaming via Amazon Prime Video. MAPPA's adaptation of Akimi Yoshida's landmark 1985 manga translated the story into contemporary New York without losing the original's core: a criminal conspiracy spanning from Vietnam-era atrocities to present-day organised crime, anchored by the relationship between Ash Lynx - a gang leader with extraordinary tactical intelligence - and Eiji Okumura, a Japanese photographer's assistant whose gentleness Ash cannot account for in his worldview. Anime News Network's Rose Bridges awarded the premiere episodes an A- and the series sustained that critical warmth through its run: an 8.1 IMDb audience score and ANN user aggregate of 7.655 placed it firmly in the upper tier of 2018 anime. The LGBTQ dimension of the Ash/Eiji bond - implicit in the original manga, more legible in the adaptation - made it a landmark title for that audience in anime specifically.

episode_reviews.title: A Perfect Day for Bananafish
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere drops into New York street crime with the efficiency of a crime novel: Ash Lynx's world is established through action rather than exposition, the Banana Fish drug appears as the central mystery, and Eiji arrives as the scene-disrupting outside element that changes the show's chemical equation. MAPPA's production quality is immediately apparent in the action choreography.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Ash and Eiji's first extended interaction - two people from entirely different worlds, one of them about to be changed by the other.

episode_reviews.title: The Old Man and the Sea
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The finale is one of the most discussed anime endings of 2018, particularly for how it handles the central relationship's resolution. The episode is calibrated for emotional devastation and delivers on its setup without evasion. Viewers who had invested in Ash and Eiji for 24 episodes reported reactions proportional to that investment.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The final letter - the scene that defined Banana Fish's emotional legacy for its audience.
